G7 BC, above the part number line, printed ".223 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G7 BC, below the part number line, printed ".218 (Oehler 89)". Marked (Oehler 89): Oehler 89 system. The velocity it applies to is not stated.
